author: Reuters
body:
Anthropic's co-founder Jack Clark said on Friday that common-sense standards were needed for AI.

Anthropic tests its AI systems and shares that information, but it should not all be voluntary, Clark added during a panel discussion at the IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok.

title: Anthropic's Jack Clark says common-sense standards are needed for AI
